title: Pi diagnostics, decisions, and acceptance contract
objective: Make Pi support operable and auditable with adapter-specific doctor checks, durable architecture decisions, user guidance, and explicit self-hosting gates.
requirements: score doctor accepts --adapter opencode or --adapter pi, defaults to OpenCode for compatibility, and checks only the selected runtime's package, authentication, and model catalog without sending a model prompt.
Pi doctor verifies Node >=22.19.0, the exact 0.84.1 SDK, valid Pi authentication, at least one authenticated discoverable model, and required packaged worker resources with stable repair guidance.

Human and JSON doctor output names the selected runtime, reports only bounded counts and versions, preserves the zero-model-request safety claim, and never exposes credentials, state paths, raw SDK errors, or model responses.

The runtime adapter documentation explains OpenCode and Pi parity, one-Pi-process-per-Agent isolation, workspace-confined custom tools, disposable context mutation, target-only candidate extraction, fail-closed completion, cancellation ownership, model and thinking selection, and the frozen-kind CLI behavior.

A durable decision records the explicit configuration union, small RuntimeAdapter interface, shared disposable Agent workspace, source-registered dispatcher, and rejection of dynamic plugin loading for this release.

The acceptance contract requires full deterministic tests plus bounded live sequential create, sequential replace, concurrent multi-file, failure, cancellation, cleanup, and first Pi-builds-SCORE runs, while keeping approval and application human-owned.
Tests prove both doctor adapters, OpenCode default compatibility, Pi failures and repairs, safe JSON/text rendering, zero prompts, and exact CLI usage.
